files.description: The sole EHI export documentation — a 4-page PDF describing the (b)(10) export mechanism. Contains screenshots of the export UI workflow (login, patient selection, export button, scheduled export configuration) and states the export format is a ZIP file containing C-CDA R2.1 documents, PDFs, HTML clinical notes, and image files. No data dictionary or field-level specification included.
Screenshot of the top of the certifications page showing vendor info, ONC/Drummond logos, and the beginning of the certified criteria list.
Screenshot of the certifications page scrolled to show the 'Electronic Health Information Export: Click Here' link alongside Real World Test plan/result links.
